propositions: The transition library signature must change from split force/reason/force_close params to unified force: str|None matching claim's shape, with legacy force_close and force=True calls mapped via deprecation aliases

CLI --force[=<reason>] must be the single approved force-bypass pattern for both transition and claim, with bare --force mapping to '(no reason given)' identically and --reason parameter no longer serving as fallback force audit note

Internal in-memory naming must unify to force_reason across transition and claim implementations, while persisting the historical status_data['force_close_reason'] key unchanged for backward compatibility
Empty-string force must bypass both start-work and completion-verify gates identically on claim and transition, with canonical explicit force input taking precedence over deprecated aliases
NDJSON import close path must revert to plain non-forcing closes to preserve pre-unification completion-gate policy and per-row fail-open warning behavior
All guidance strings in gates.py, txn.py, and transition.py must show only the --force[=<reason>] pattern with no --reason-as-force-note or force=bool/force_close wording
